dedupe_keys.name: pedestrian trajectory dataset of public european squares

description: The research dataset contains 348,200 pedestrian trajectories extracted from 193 hours of public-webcam footage at 39 European squares. The authors used YOLOv10, ByteTrack and spatial processing to reconstruct movement during selected spring and summer periods. Camera placement, tracking errors and the sampled periods limit representativeness; these are processed observations, not complete pedestrian demand for each city. Published by Wolff and Perry / MIT and Wageningen. Spatial and temporal resolution are source-dependent; any detail not stated above remains unknown. The provider page is the access route; underlying file formats were not confirmed. Licence: CC-BY-4.0, read from the Zenodo record on 2026-09-27; obtaining it is free of charge. Potential simulation uses include capacity planning, hazard exposure. Related catalogue records: platform-qgis. These are contextual links, not a claim of a tested integration.
